comment:
* Implement the per-application based SMS control, which limits the number of
 * SMS/MMS messages an app can send in the checking period.
 *
 * This code was formerly part of {@link SMSDispatcher}, and has been moved
 * into a separate class to support instantiation of multiple SMSDispatchers on
 * dual-mode devices that require support for both 3GPP and 3GPP2 format messages.

variables.name: DEFAULT_SMS_CHECK_PERIOD
variables.comment: 1 minute

variables.name: DEFAULT_SMS_MAX_COUNT
variables.comment: Default number of SMS sent in checking period without user permission.

variables.name: PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_UNKNOWN
variables.comment: Premium SMS permission for a new package (ask user when first premium SMS sent).

variables.name: PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ASK_USER
variables.comment: Default premium SMS permission (ask user for each premium SMS sent).

variables.name: PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_NEVER_ALLOW
variables.comment: Premium SMS permission when the owner has denied the app from sending premium SMS.

variables.name: PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ALWAYS_ALLOW
variables.comment: Premium SMS permission when the owner has allowed the app to send premium SMS.

variables.name: mContext
variables.comment: Context for retrieving regexes from XML resource.

variables.name: mCurrentCountry
variables.comment: Country code for the cached short code pattern matcher.

variables.name: mCurrentPatternMatcher
variables.comment: Cached short code pattern matcher for {@link #mCurrentCountry}.

variables.name: mCheckEnabled
variables.comment: Notice when the enabled setting changes - can be changed through gservices

variables.name: mSettingsObserverHandler
variables.comment: Handler for responding to content observer updates.

variables.name: mPatternFile
variables.comment: File holding the patterns

variables.name: mPatternFileLastModified
variables.comment: Last modified time for pattern file

variables.name: SMS_POLICY_FILE_DIRECTORY
variables.comment: Directory for per-app SMS permission XML file.

variables.name: SMS_POLICY_FILE_NAME
variables.comment: Per-app SMS permission XML filename.

variables.name: TAG_SHORTCODES
variables.comment: XML tag for root element.

variables.name: TAG_SHORTCODE
variables.comment: XML tag for short code patterns for a specific country.

variables.name: ATTR_COUNTRY
variables.comment: XML attribute for the country code.

variables.name: ATTR_PATTERN
variables.comment: XML attribute for the short code regex pattern.

variables.name: ATTR_PREMIUM
variables.comment: XML attribute for the premium short code regex pattern.

variables.name: ATTR_FREE
variables.comment: XML attribute for the free short code regex pattern.

variables.name: ATTR_STANDARD
variables.comment: XML attribute for the standard rate short code regex pattern.

variables.name: mPolicyFile
variables.comment: Stored copy of premium SMS package permissions.

variables.name: mPremiumSmsPolicy
variables.comment: Loaded copy of premium SMS package permissions.

variables.name: TAG_SMS_POLICY_BODY
variables.comment: XML tag for root element of premium SMS permissions.

variables.name: TAG_PACKAGE
variables.comment: XML tag for a package.

variables.name: ATTR_PACKAGE_NAME
variables.comment: XML attribute for the package name.

variables.name: ATTR_PACKAGE_SMS_POLICY
variables.comment: XML attribute for the package's premium SMS permission (integer type).

methods.name: public boolean check(String appName, int smsWaiting)
methods.comment:
* Check to see if an application is allowed to send new SMS messages, and confirm with
     * user if the send limit was reached or if a non-system app is potentially sending to a
     * premium SMS short code or number. If the app is the default SMS app, there's no send limit.
     *
     * @param appName the package name of the app requesting to send an SMS
     * @param smsWaiting the number of new messages desired to send
     * @return true if application is allowed to send the requested number
     *  of new sms messages

methods.name: public int checkDestination(String destAddress, String countryIso)
methods.comment:
* Check if the destination is a possible premium short code.
     * NOTE: the caller is expected to strip non-digits from the destination number with
     * {@link PhoneNumberUtils#extractNetworkPortion} before calling this method.
     * This happens in {@link SMSDispatcher#sendRawPdu} so that we use the same phone number
     * for testing and in the user confirmation dialog if the user needs to confirm the number.
     * This makes it difficult for malware to fool the user or the short code pattern matcher
     * by using non-ASCII characters to make the number appear to be different from the real
     * destination phone number.
     *
     * @param destAddress the destination address to test for possible short code
     * @return {@link SmsManager#SMS_CATEGORY_FREE_SHORT_CODE},
     * {@link SmsManager#SMS_CATEGORY_NOT_SHORT_CODE},
     *  {@link SmsManager#SMS_CATEGORY_POSSIBLE_PREMIUM_SHORT_CODE},
     *  {@link SmsManager#SMS_CATEGORY_STANDARD_SHORT_CODE}, or
     *  {@link SmsManager#SMS_CATEGORY_POSSIBLE_PREMIUM_SHORT_CODE}

methods.name: public int getPremiumSmsPermission(String packageName)
methods.comment:
* Returns the premium SMS permission for the specified package. If the package has never
     * been seen before, the default {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_UNKNOWN}
     * will be returned.
     * @param packageName the name of the package to query permission
     * @return one of {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_UNKNOWN},
     *  {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ASK_USER},
     *  {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_NEVER_ALLOW}, or
     *  {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ALWAYS_ALLOW}
     * @throws SecurityException if the caller is not a system process

methods.name: public void setPremiumSmsPermission(String packageName, int permission)
methods.comment:
* Sets the premium SMS permission for the specified package and save the value asynchronously
     * to persistent storage.
     * @param packageName the name of the package to set permission
     * @param permission one of {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ASK_USER},
     *  {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_NEVER_ALLOW}, or
     *  {@link #PREMIUM_SMS_PERMISSION_ALWAYS_ALLOW}
     * @throws SecurityException if the caller is not a system process

methods.comment:
